name: Rajat Chaturvedi
summary: Frontend engineer with 5+ years building customer-facing web and mobile experiences with React, Next.js, React Native, and TypeScript. Currently at Best Buy India, I work on Ask Blue's conversational commerce experience, micro-frontends, and shared UI systems.
paragraphs: My work spans enterprise e-commerce, payment integrations, performance optimization, and frontend team leadership. Highlights include a 35% reduction in feature-delivery cycles, 60% fewer order-processing errors, and an Ask Blue caching layer achieving under 1s LCP and 0 CLS. I build reusable components, resilient data flows, and automated CI/CD checks to keep delivery fast and maintainable.
